spans.text: In World War II, Greece was first invaded by Italy (1940) and subsequently occupied by Germany (1941-44); fighting endured in a protracted civil war between supporters of the king and other anti-communist and communist rebels.
The communists were defeated in 1949, and Greece joined NATO in 1952.
